title: Detroit: Become Human
provenance: Reported by daniel-kub (highball#125, 2026-09-16), Apple M2 8 GB, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.19: on the default engine the game warned about the GPU and crashed; on the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r10 its launcher compiled shaders slowly and stopped at 98 percent. The maintainer tried the free demo (Steam 1224230) on 2026-09-26. On 2026-11-07 udance4ever (highball#125) played it on a base M1 with 16 GB on the Wine 11 engine r30 or r31 from Highball 0.10.26, whose MoltenVK carries fixes ported from DiAvisoo's changes (found working in Highball by udance4ever and jason312928). raaaaj214 (highball-db#1431, 2026-11-24), Apple M2, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r30, DXMT as the environment's mode, which this game doesn't use since it draws through MoltenVK, rated 3 of 5 after 47 minutes: with HB_MVK_LENIENT_INTERFACES=1, MVK_CONFIG_SHADER_COMPRESSION_ALGORITHM=1, MVK_CONFIG_SHOULD_MAXIMIZE_CONCURRENT_COMPILATION=0 (the recipe sets 1), MTL_SHADER_CACHE_SIZE=2147483648 and MVK_CONFIG_LOG_LEVEL=0 set in the environment and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes, not the game's recipe. Frame drops, and the picture isn't drawn properly, not described further. Petko6 (highball-db#1478, 2026-11-26), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.29, engine x64-crossover26.3-r31, DXMT as the environment's mode, which this game doesn't use since it draws through MoltenVK, rated 3 of 5 after 12 minutes: with the game's recipe and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes, a few minutes into the second mission. The game doesn't start unless VkPipelineCache.bin is deleted before every launch. The player removed the blur in the foreground with the community hex edit of the exe, then turned HDR off in GraphicOptions.JSON because the picture was overexposed. A few stutters here and there.
notes: The game draws with Vulkan directly, through MoltenVK, so the graphics mode does not apply. It plays on the Wine 11 engine r30 or r31 with three variables, which the recipe sets (HB_MVK_LENIENT_INTERFACES=1, MVK_CONFIG_SHADER_COMPRESSION_ALGORITHM=1, MVK_CONFIG_SHOULD_MAXIMIZE_CONCURRENT_COMPILATION=1). On a base M1 with 16 GB the launcher's shader step took about two minutes and the game ran at about 20 fps with little stutter (udance4ever, 2026-11-07). Its launcher first shows a 'graphics card not officially supported' warning, press OK. Older engines stopped at 98 percent in the shader step or showed only a spinner.

knownIssues.symptom: Launcher's shader compile stops at 98 percent, or shows only a spinner (engine r10, highball#125).
knownIssues.cause: MoltenVK lacked workarounds the game needs. Which of the ported changes cures the stop is not isolated.
knownIssues.fix: Wine 11 engine r30 or r31 with HB_MVK_LENIENT_INTERFACES=1, which the recipe sets.

knownIssues.symptom: Shader step takes about 22 minutes and the game stutters badly (base M1 16 GB, r30 or r31).
knownIssues.cause: not isolated. The variable compresses the shader source MoltenVK keeps in memory, and the difference was measured by the reporter.

knownIssues.symptom: A blur over parts of the picture every so often.
knownIssues.cause: the game's post processing under MoltenVK, a community patch to the exe removes it.
knownIssues.fix: none in Highball, which does not change game files. The reporter of highball-db#1478 removed it with the community hex edit of the exe

knownIssues.symptom: Frame drops, and the picture isn't drawn properly, not described further (M2, Wine 11 r30, the variables set by hand with concurrent compilation off, highball-db#1431)
knownIssues.fix: none tested. The game's recipe asks for the Wine 11 engine r31 or newer with MVK_CONFIG_SHOULD_MAXIMIZE_CONCURRENT_COMPILATION=1

knownIssues.symptom: The game doesn't start unless VkPipelineCache.bin is deleted before each launch (M3 Pro, Wine 11 r31, the game's recipe, highball-db#1478)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The file is the game's own Vulkan pipeline cache from the run before, so MoltenVK most likely fails on the cache it's handed back, a guess
knownIssues.fix: delete VkPipelineCache.bin before each launch, by the reporter. Where the game keeps it isn't stated

knownIssues.symptom: With HDR on the picture is overexposed (M3 Pro, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1478)
knownIssues.fix: turn HDR off in the game's GraphicOptions.JSON, by the reporter
